name: Grace
source: Grace is very outgoing and carefree. She respects people and even when she enjoys putting them in difficulty, she never exaggerates. She likes sex, she is lustful but only with those she deems worthy. She is not touchy, rarely gets offended or upset, no matter what happens. She never gets angry and takes everything philosophically. She frequents the art club.
